# Prep tables for PICRUST
```{r}
ps_gut_clean <- readRDS(file = "Results/ps_gut_microDecon_clean.rds")

library(phyloseq)
library(Biostrings)

# ---------------------------
# MAKE OUTPUT DIR
# ---------------------------
dir.create("PICRUST", showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------
# FEATURE TABLE (PICRUSt2 format)
# ---------------------------
otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_gut_clean))

if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_gut_clean)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}

write.table(
  otu,
  file = "PICRUST/feature_table.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  col.names = NA,
  row.names = TRUE
)

# ---------------------------
# CLEAN FASTA EXPORT (CRITICAL FIX)
# ---------------------------

ps_original <- readRDS(
  "/Users/callumjameshudson/Desktop/Urchin Microbiome/Shikine Urchin Microbiome/Results/ps.rds"
)

refseq(ps_original)[1:5]

head(taxa_names(ps_original))
head(names(refseq(ps_original)))

dna <- refseq(ps_original)[taxa_names(ps_gut_clean)]

ps_gut_clean <- merge_phyloseq(
  ps_gut_clean,
  dna
)

length(refseq(ps_gut_clean))
ntaxa(ps_gut_clean)

# clean ASV names (removes hidden characters if any exist)
names(dna) <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "", taxa_names(ps_gut_clean))

# FORCE SINGLE-LINE FASTA (PICRUSt2 SAFE)
writeLines(
  paste0(">", names(dna), "\n", as.character(dna)),
  con = "PICRUST/rep_seqs.fasta"
)

# ---------------------------
# TAXONOMY (optional)
# ---------------------------
tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_gut_clean))

write.table(
  tax,
  file = "PICRUST/taxonomy.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  col.names = NA,
  row.names = TRUE
)

# ---------------------------
# FINAL SANITY CHECKS
# ---------------------------

dim(otu_table(ps_gut_clean))
length(taxa_names(ps_gut_clean))

dim(otu)
otu[1:5, 1:5]

head(rownames(otu))
head(colnames(otu))

dna <- refseq(ps_gut_clean)
names(dna) <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "", taxa_names(ps_gut_clean))

length(names(dna))
length(rownames(otu))

sum(rownames(otu) %in% names(dna))

head(grep(" ", rownames(otu), value = TRUE))
head(grep(";", rownames(otu), value = TRUE))
```

# Input PICRUST outputs
```{r}
library(ggpicrust2)
library(tidyverse)

# =========================================================
# LOAD PICRUST2 KO TABLE
# =========================================================

ko <- read.delim(
  gzfile("PICRUST/Outputs/KO_metagenome_out/pred_metagenome_unstrat.tsv.gz"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Set KO IDs as row names
rownames(ko) <- ko[, 1]
ko <- ko[, -1]

dim(ko)
head(rownames(ko))
head(colnames(ko))


# =========================================================
# LOAD METADATA
# =========================================================

metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_gut_clean))

# Use the phyloseq sample names so they exactly match PICRUSt2
metadata$SampleID <- sample_names(ps_gut_clean)

# Check IDs
head(metadata$ID)
head(metadata$SampleID)
head(colnames(ko))


# =========================================================
# MATCH KO TABLE AND METADATA
# =========================================================

common <- intersect(colnames(ko), metadata$SampleID)

length(common)
common


# Keep only samples present in both datasets
ko <- ko[, common, drop = FALSE]

metadata <- metadata[
  metadata$SampleID %in% common,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Reorder metadata to exactly match KO table
metadata <- metadata[
  match(colnames(ko), metadata$SampleID),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Confirm exact matching
stopifnot(all(metadata$SampleID == colnames(ko)))

cat("Samples matched:", length(common), "\n")


# =========================================================
# DEFINE SITE / CONDITION
# =========================================================

metadata$Site <- metadata$Condition

table(metadata$Site)


# =========================================================
# REMOVE KOs WITH ZERO ABUNDANCE ACROSS ALL SAMPLES
# =========================================================

ko <- ko[
  ,
  colSums(ko, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
  drop = FALSE
]


# =========================================================
# CHECK KO IDs
# =========================================================

ko_df <- as.data.frame(ko, check.names = FALSE)

rownames(ko_df) <- rownames(ko)

stopifnot(all(grepl("^K", rownames(ko_df))))

head(rownames(ko_df))
head(colnames(ko_df))


# =========================================================
# FORMAT FOR GGPICRUST2
# =========================================================

ko_clean <- as.data.frame(
  ko,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Explicitly set KO IDs as the first column
ko_clean <- cbind(
  KO = rownames(ko_clean),
  ko_clean
)

rownames(ko_clean) <- NULL

head(ko_clean)

result <- ggpicrust2(
  data = ko_clean,
  metadata = metadata,
  group = "Site",
  reference = "Reference",   # IMPORTANT
  pathway = "KO",
  p_adjust_method = "BH",
  daa_method = "ALDEx2",
  ko_to_kegg = TRUE,                
  filter_for_prokaryotes = TRUE, 
)

res <- result[[1]]$results
head(res)

non_bacterial <- c(
  
  # Plant-specific / plant-associated pathways
  "Photosynthesis",
  "Carbon fixation by Calvin cycle",
  "Other carbon fixation pathways",
  "Zeatin biosynthesis",
  "Isoflavonoid biosynthesis",
  "Degradation of flavonoids",
  "Glucosinolate biosynthesis",
  "Betalain biosynthesis",
  "Tropane, piperidine and pyridine alkaloid biosynthesis",
  "Isoquinoline alkaloid biosynthesis",
  "Plant hormone signal transduction",
  
  # Eukaryotic glycan pathways
  "N-Glycan biosynthesis",
  "Various types of N-glycan biosynthesis",
  "Glycosphingolipid biosynthesis - globo and isoglobo series",
  "Glycosphingolipid biosynthesis - ganglio series",
  
  # Eukaryotic signalling / cellular pathways
  "HIF-1 signaling pathway",
  "FoxO signaling pathway",
  "Phospholipase D signaling pathway",
  "PI3K-Akt signaling pathway",
  "Lysosome biogenesis",
  "Peroxisome",
  "Apoptosis",
  "Ferroptosis",
  "Necroptosis",
  "MAPK signaling pathway - fly",
  "MAPK signaling pathway - yeast",
  "Autophagy - yeast",
  "Mitophagy - animal",
  "Meiosis - yeast",
  "Apoptosis - fly",
  "Cytoskeleton in muscle cells",
  "Protein processing in endoplasmic reticulum",
  
  # Viral
  "Viral life cycle - HIV-1",
  "Virion - Hepatitis viruses",
  
  # Host/pathogen infection pathways
  "Vibrio cholerae infection",
  "Epithelial cell signaling in Helicobacter pylori infection",
  "Salmonella infection",
  "Shigellosis",
  "Yersinia infection",
  
  # Animal/eukaryotic-specific pathways
  "Steroid hormone biosynthesis",
  
  # Other clearly eukaryote/plant secondary metabolism
  "Indole alkaloid biosynthesis"
)

res_filtered <- res %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_adjust < 0.05) %>%
  filter(!pathway_name %in% non_bacterial)


View(res_filtered)
```

# Plots
```{r}

sig <- res_filtered %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_adjust < 0.05, !is.na(log2_fold_change)) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = ifelse(log2_fold_change > 0,
                        "Higher in Elevated CO2",
                        "Higher in Reference")
  )

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(res_filtered, aes(x = log2_fold_change, y = -log10(p_adjust))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Log2 fold change (Elevated CO2 vs Reference)",
    y = "-log10 adjusted p-value"
  )

top_up <- sig %>%
  filter(direction == "Higher in Elevated CO2") %>%
  arrange(desc(log2_fold_change))

top_down <- sig %>%
  filter(direction == "Higher in Reference") %>%
  arrange(log2_fold_change) 

top_plot <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down)


level_order1 <- c("Reference", "Elevated CO2")
disp.pal1 <- c("#2C728E", "#D4476C")

ggplot(top_plot, aes(x = reorder(pathway_name, log2_fold_change),
                     y = log2_fold_change,
                     fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Higher in Reference" = "#2C728E",
    "Higher in Elevated CO2" = "#D4476C"
  )) +
  labs(x = "KEGG pathway", y = "Log2 fold change")

```


# Final plot 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

top_plot <- top_plot %>%
  filter(
    p_adjust < 0.05,
    abs(log2_fold_change) > 0.5
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    class = trimws(sub(";.*", "", pathway_class)),
    neglog10_p = -log10(p_adjust),
    direction = ifelse(
      log2_fold_change > 0,
      "Elevated CO2",
      "Reference"
    ),
    pathway_label = pathway_name
  ) %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  arrange(desc(log2_fold_change), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    pathway_label = factor(
      pathway_label,
      levels = rev(unique(pathway_label))
    )
  )

kegg_picrust <- ggplot(
  top_plot,
  aes(
    x = pathway_label,
    y = log2_fold_change,
    fill = direction,
    alpha = neglog10_p
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic() +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Reference" = "#2C728E",
      "Elevated CO2" = "#D4476C"
    ),
    name = "Enrichment"
  ) +

  scale_alpha_continuous(
    range = c(0.3, 1),
    name = expression(-log[10]~"adjusted p-value")
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "KEGG Class: Pathway",
    y = "Log2 fold change"
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.8
    )
  )

kegg_picrust

ggsave(
  filename = "PICRUST/Figures/New_KEGG_Pathway_LFC.svg",
  plot = kegg_picrust,
  width = 20,
  height = 15,
  units = "cm"
)

View(top_plot)
```


# MetaCyc
```{r}
library(ggpicrust2)
library(tidyverse)

# =========================================================
# LOAD PICRUST2 METACYC PATHWAY TABLE
# =========================================================

metacyc <- read.delim(
  gzfile("PICRUST/Outputs/pathways_out/path_abun_unstrat.tsv.gz"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Set MetaCyc pathway IDs as row names
rownames(metacyc) <- metacyc[, 1]
metacyc <- metacyc[, -1]

dim(metacyc)
head(rownames(metacyc))
head(colnames(metacyc))


# =========================================================
# LOAD METADATA
# =========================================================

metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_gut_clean))

# Use phyloseq sample names so they exactly match PICRUSt2
metadata$SampleID <- sample_names(ps_gut_clean)

# Check IDs
head(metadata$ID)
head(metadata$SampleID)
head(colnames(metacyc))


# =========================================================
# MATCH METACYC TABLE AND METADATA
# =========================================================

common <- intersect(
  colnames(metacyc),
  metadata$SampleID
)

length(common)
common


# Keep only samples present in both datasets
metacyc <- metacyc[
  ,
  common,
  drop = FALSE
]

metadata <- metadata[
  metadata$SampleID %in% common,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Reorder metadata to exactly match MetaCyc table
metadata <- metadata[
  match(colnames(metacyc), metadata$SampleID),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Confirm exact matching
stopifnot(
  all(metadata$SampleID == colnames(metacyc))
)

cat("Samples matched:", length(common), "\n")


# =========================================================
# DEFINE SITE / CONDITION
# =========================================================

metadata$Site <- metadata$Condition

table(metadata$Site)


# =========================================================
# REMOVE METACYC PATHWAYS WITH ZERO ABUNDANCE
# =========================================================

metacyc <- metacyc[
  rowSums(metacyc, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


# =========================================================
# CHECK METACYC PATHWAY IDs
# =========================================================

metacyc_df <- as.data.frame(
  metacyc,
  check.names = FALSE
)

rownames(metacyc_df) <- rownames(metacyc)

head(rownames(metacyc_df))
head(colnames(metacyc_df))


# =========================================================
# FORMAT FOR GGPICRUST2
# =========================================================

metacyc_clean <- as.data.frame(
  metacyc,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Explicitly set pathway IDs as the first column
metacyc_clean <- cbind(
  Pathway = rownames(metacyc_clean),
  metacyc_clean
)

rownames(metacyc_clean) <- NULL

head(metacyc_clean)


# =========================================================
# GGPICRUST2 — METACYC PATHWAY DAA
# =========================================================

result_metacyc <- ggpicrust2(
  data = metacyc_clean,
  metadata = metadata,
  group = "Site",
  reference = "Reference",
  pathway = "MetaCyc",
  p_adjust_method = "BH",
  daa_method = "ALDEx2",
  ko_to_kegg = FALSE
)

res_metacyc <- result_metacyc[[1]]$results

head(res_metacyc)


# =========================================================
# SIGNIFICANT PATHWAYS
# =========================================================

sig_metacyc <- res_metacyc %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_adjust < 0.05)

View(sig_metacyc)

```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# SELECT METAcyc PATHWAYS WITH |LFC| > 1
# =========================================================

top_plot <- res_metacyc %>%
  filter(
    p_adjust < 0.05,
    abs(log2_fold_change) > 1
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10_p = -log10(p_adjust),
    direction = ifelse(
      log2_fold_change > 0,
      "Elevated CO2",
      "Reference"
    ),
    pathway_label = description
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(log2_fold_change)) %>%
  mutate(
    pathway_label = factor(
      pathway_label,
      levels = rev(unique(pathway_label))
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# PLOT
# =========================================================

metacyc_picrust <- ggplot(
  top_plot,
  aes(
    x = pathway_label,
    y = log2_fold_change,
    fill = direction,
    alpha = neglog10_p
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic() +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Reference" = "#2C728E",
      "Elevated CO2" = "#D4476C"
    ),
    name = "Enrichment"
  ) +

  scale_alpha_continuous(
    range = c(0.3, 1),
    name = expression(-log[10]~"adjusted p-value")
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "MetaCyc pathway",
    y = "Log2 fold change"
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.8
    )
  )

metacyc_picrust

ggsave(
  filename = "PICRUST/Figures/New_MetaCyc_LFC.svg",
  plot = metacyc_picrust,
  width = 25,
  height = 15,
  units = "cm"
)
```



```{r}
metacyc <- read.delim(
  gzfile("PICRUST/Outputs/pathways_out/path_abun_unstrat.tsv.gz"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

rownames(metacyc) <- metacyc[,1]
metacyc <- metacyc[,-1]

colnames(metacyc) <- gsub("^Shikine_", "", colnames(metacyc))
colnames(metacyc) <- sub("_S.*", "", colnames(metacyc))
colnames(metacyc) <- sub("_R1.*", "", colnames(metacyc))

metadata$SampleID <- gsub("^Shikine_", "", metadata$SampleID)
metadata$SampleID <- sub("_S.*", "", metadata$SampleID)

common <- intersect(colnames(metacyc), metadata$SampleID)

metacyc <- metacyc[, common]
metadata <- metadata[metadata$SampleID %in% common, ]
metadata <- metadata[match(colnames(metacyc), metadata$SampleID), ]
```



```{r}
metacyc_clean <- as.data.frame(metacyc, check.names = FALSE)

metacyc_clean <- cbind(Pathway = rownames(metacyc_clean), metacyc_clean)
rownames(metacyc_clean) <- NULL

result_metacyc <- ggpicrust2(
  data = metacyc_clean,
  metadata = metadata,
  group = "Site",
  reference = "Reference",
  pathway = "MetaCyc",
  p_adjust_method = "BH",
  daa_method = "ALDEx2"
)

res_metacyc <- result_metacyc[[1]]$results

sig_metacyc <- res_metacyc %>%
  filter(p_adjust < 0.05, !is.na(log2_fold_change))

sig_metacyc <- sig_metacyc %>%
  mutate(
    direction = ifelse(log2_fold_change > 0,
                       "Higher in Elevated CO2",
                       "Higher in Reference")
  )


ggplot(res_metacyc, aes(x = log2_fold_change, y = -log10(p_adjust))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_classic()

top_metacyc <- sig_metacyc %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10_p = -log10(p_adjust)
  ) %>%
  arrange(log2_fold_change)

metacyc_picrust <- ggplot(
  top_metacyc,
  aes(
    x = reorder(description, log2_fold_change),
    y = log2_fold_change,
    fill = direction,
    alpha = neglog10_p
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Higher in Reference" = "#2C728E",
      "Higher in Elevated CO2" = "#D4476C"
    ),
    name = "Enrichment"
  ) +
  scale_alpha_continuous(
    range = c(0.3, 1),
    name = expression(-log[10]~"adjusted p-value")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "MetaCyc pathway",
    y = "Log2 fold change"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.8
    )
  )

metacyc_picrust
ggsave(
  filename = "PICRUST/Figures/MetaCyc_Pathway_LFC.svg",
  plot = metacyc_picrust,
  width = 25,
  height = 15,
  units = "cm"
)
```
